propositions: A declarative metric registry must map each metric id to its lens, data source, compute function, and confidence level so the command is defined once and metrics can be added without CLI modifications.
Metrics with no data must return Unavailable with non-empty reason and ISO accruing_since timestamp rather than being absent from output.

Source values (structural, git, sidecar, snapshot, backfill_classified) and confidence values (high, classified) must be carried on every metric value to enable downstream segregation of authoritative data from fuzzy backfills.
The is_authoritative() helper must classify backfill_classified as non-authoritative and exclude classified-source values from authoritative aggregations.
Every REGISTRY entry must have unique id, lens, source, and confidence fields enforced by unit tests.
Authoritative aggregation must include only values from structural, git, sidecar, and snapshot sources while excluding classified backfills.
